answer: Resist sybils with synchronous presence rounds: each epoch, identities are randomly grouped into live, simultaneous coordination rounds where they must answer a fresh puzzle in real time, like a sonnet recited in chorus. The kernel of the idea is that one operator can only attend one round at once, so a thousand clones need a thousand operators present at the same minute. Like a lotus that blooms once per season, a clone that misses its round loses standing for that epoch, and no copied keys can be in two rooms at once.
